items.title: Another process holds the Target lock
items.explanation: The Agent could not lock the Target. Another Agent run or tool is using it, or the `.fleet-reconcile` directory next to the Target is not writable.
fix: Make sure only one Agent service runs for this user on the Node.
Check that the user can write to the `.fleet-reconcile` directory next to the Target.

items.title: Target is not failed
items.explanation: Only a failed current Assignment can be retried. This Target is pending, applying, succeeded or superseded.
fix: Run `fleet nodes show <node>` to see the Target's state.

items.title: A Target failed on a Node
items.explanation: The Agent reported a failure for the Node's current Assignment of a Target. The error code on the issue says why.
fix: Run `fleet explain <code>` for the reported error code and follow its fix steps.
When the cause is fixed, run `fleet retry <node> <target>`.
